request: how do you share 7 pizzas equally between 3 people?

beats.intent: Seven pizza circles in a row
beats.code:
stage.title("7 pizzas, 3 people")
pizzas = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.55, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.6) for _ in range(7)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.25).move_to([0, 1.2, 0])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(p) for p in pizzas], lag_ratio=0.1))
stage.add(pizzas)

beats.intent: Six whole pizzas given out, two to each person, one left
beats.narration: Hand out whole pizzas first: two each uses six. One is left over.
beats.code:
cols = [BLUE, GREEN, RED]
for k in range(6):
    stage.play(pizzas[k].animate.set_fill(cols[k // 2], opacity=0.7), run_time=0.2)
stage.caption("2 each, 1 left")

beats.intent: The last pizza cut into 3 equal slices, one per person
beats.narration: Cut the last one into three equal slices, one each.
beats.code:
last = pizzas[6]
slices = VGroup(*[Sector(radius=0.55, start_angle=PI / 2 + k * TAU / 3, angle=TAU / 3, color=WHITE, fill_color=cols[k], fill_opacity=0.8).move_arc_center_to(last.get_center()) for k in range(3)])
stage.play(FadeOut(last), FadeIn(slices))
stage.add(slices)
stage.caption("the last pizza in thirds")

beats.narration: So each person gets two and a third pizzas.

request: how many snaps to break a 4 by 6 chocolate bar into squares?

beats.intent: A chocolate bar of 4 rows and 6 columns
beats.narration: A bar of chocolate, four squares by six: twenty four squares.
beats.code:
stage.title("Breaking a chocolate bar")
bar = VGroup(*[Square(0.6, color=GREY_B, fill_color="#6b3e1d", fill_opacity=1) for _ in range(24)]).arrange_in_grid(rows=4, cols=6, buff=0.04).move_to([0, 0, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(bar))
stage.add(bar)
stage.caption("24 squares")

beats.intent: The first snap splitting it into two pieces, 8 and 16 squares
beats.narration: Every snap breaks one piece into two, so each snap adds exactly one piece.
beats.code:
top = VGroup(*bar[:6], *bar[6:12])
stage.play(VGroup(*bar[:12]).animate.shift(0.4 * UP), VGroup(*bar[12:]).animate.shift(0.4 * DOWN))
stage.caption("1 snap: 2 pieces")

beats.intent: The rows pulled apart into strips, then strips into single squares, a counter reading 23
beats.narration: Keep snapping until every square is loose. You start with one piece and need twenty four, however you do it.
beats.code:
stage.play(*[sq.animate.shift(((k % 6) - 2.5) * 0.25 * RIGHT + ((k // 6) - 1.5) * 0.25 * DOWN) for k, sq in enumerate(bar)])
stage.caption("23 snaps: 24 pieces")

beats.narration: So it always takes twenty three snaps: pieces minus one.

request: how does a trebuchet throw so far?

beats.intent: A trebuchet: a long arm on a pivot, a heavy weight on the short end, a sling on the long end
beats.narration: A trebuchet is a see-saw with a huge weight on its short end and a sling on its long end.
beats.code:
stage.title("The trebuchet")
pivot = np.array([-1.0, -0.6, 0])
frame = Polygon([-2.2, -2.6, 0], [0.2, -2.6, 0], pivot, color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.3)
arm = Line(pivot + 1.2 * np.array([-0.8, -0.6, 0]), pivot + 3.0 * np.array([0.8, 0.6, 0]), color=ORANGE, stroke_width=8)
weight = Square(0.9, color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=1).move_to(arm.get_start())
stone = Dot(arm.get_end(), color=WHITE, radius=0.15)
stage.play(FadeIn(frame), Create(arm), FadeIn(weight), FadeIn(stone))
stage.add(frame, arm, weight, stone)
g = VGroup(arm, weight, stone)
stage.play(Rotate(g, -1.1, about_point=pivot))
stage.caption("weight raised, arm cocked")

beats.intent: The weight dropping and the long arm swinging up fast
beats.narration: Let go. The weight falls a short way, and the long arm swings through a big arc, very fast.
beats.code:
stage.play(Rotate(g, 1.9, about_point=pivot), run_time=0.8, rate_func=rate_functions.rush_into)
stage.caption("short drop, big fast swing")

beats.intent: The stone released from the tip flying off along a long curved path
beats.narration: At the top of the swing the stone is let go and flies off along a long curve.
beats.code:
start = stone.get_center()
path = VMobject(color=YELLOW).set_points_smoothly([start, start + np.array([2.0, 0.5, 0]), start + np.array([4.0, 0.0, 0]), start + np.array([6.0, -3.0, 0])])
stage.play(MoveAlongPath(stone, path), Create(path), run_time=1.5)
stage.add(path)

beats.intent: The picture beside: the long arm is 2.5 times the short one, so the tip moves 2.5 times as fast
beats.narration: Because the long arm is two and a half times the short one, its tip moves two and a half times as fast as the falling weight.

beats.intent: A star far above and an eye below, with a layer of air between
beats.narration: Starlight crosses space in a straight line, then passes through our moving atmosphere.
beats.code:
stage.title("Why stars twinkle")
star = Star(5, outer_radius=0.35, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=1).move_to([0, 2.6, 0])
eye = Ellipse(width=0.8, height=0.4, color=WHITE).move_to([0, -2.8, 0])
air = Rectangle(width=9, height=2.4, stroke_width=0, fill_color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.15).move_to([0, -0.8, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(star), Create(eye), FadeIn(air))
stage.add(star, eye, air)
stage.label(air, "moving air", direction=RIGHT, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: A wobbly ray bending in the air layer and still reaching the eye
beats.narration: Pockets of warmer and cooler air bend the light slightly, and they keep moving.

beats.intent: The ray shifting sideways so it sometimes misses the eye
beats.narration: So the path wanders: sometimes more light reaches your eye, sometimes less.
beats.code:
ray2 = VMobject(color=YELLOW).set_points_smoothly([[0, 2.2, 0], [0, 0.4, 0], [-0.3, -0.4, 0], [0.5, -1.3, 0], [0.9, -2.6, 0]])
stage.play(Transform(ray, ray2))
stage.play(star.animate.set_opacity(0.35), run_time=0.3)
stage.play(star.animate.set_opacity(1), run_time=0.3)
stage.caption("the path wanders: the star flickers")

beats.intent: A planet beside the star with a thicker bundle of rays, shining steadily
beats.narration: Planets are close enough to look like tiny discs, not points. Their many rays average out, so they shine steadily.
beats.code:
planet = Circle(radius=0.3, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=1).move_to([4.0, 2.6, 0])
bundle = VGroup(*[Line([4.0 + dx, 2.3, 0], [4.0 + dx * 0.3, -2.4, 0], color=ORANGE, stroke_width=2) for dx in np.linspace(-0.25, 0.25, 5)])
stage.play(FadeIn(planet), Create(bundle))
stage.add(planet, bundle)
stage.label(planet, "planet: steady", direction=RIGHT, color=ORANGE)
